'''Stefan Bringezu''' is a [[Germans|German]] environmental scientist. He has conducted pioneering research in the field of material flow analysis<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Fischer-Kowalski |first1=M. |last2=Krausmann |first2=F. |last3=Giljum |first3=S. |last4=Lutter |first4=S. |last5=Mayer |first5=A. |last6=Bringezu |first6=S. |last7=Moriguchi |first7=Y. |last8=Schütz |first8=H. |last9=Schandl |first9=H. |last10=Weisz |first10=H. |date=2011-08-31 |title=Methodology and Indicators of Economy-wide Material Flow Accounting |journal=Journal of Industrial Ecology |volume=15 |issue=6 |pages=855–876 |doi=10.1111/j.1530-9290.2011.00366.x |issn=1088-1980|doi-access=free |bibcode=2011JInEc..15..855F }}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Bringezu |first=Stefan |title=Ressourcennutzung in Wirtschaftsräumen: Stoffstromanalysen für eine nachhaltige Raumentwicklung; mit 11 Tabellen |date=2000 |publisher=Springer |isbn=978-3-540-66886-2 |location=Berlin Heidelberg}}</ref> and derived policy-relevant indicators of resource use,<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Aoki-Suzuki |first1=Chika |last2=Bengtsson |first2=Magnus |last3=Hotta |first3=Yasuhiko |date=2012-06-07 |title=International Comparison and Suggestions for Capacity Development in Industrializing Countries |url=http://dx.doi.org/10.1111/j.1530-9290.2012.00480.x |journal=Journal of Industrial Ecology |volume=16 |issue=4 |pages=467–480 |doi=10.1111/j.1530-9290.2012.00480.x |bibcode=2012JInEc..16..467A |s2cid=152700380 |issn=1088-1980|url-access=subscription }}</ref> which contributed to statistical standards in the [[European Union|EU]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Economy-wide material flow accounts and derived indicators - A methodological guide (PDF) |url=https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/products-manuals-and-guidelines/-/ks-34-00-536 |access-date=2023-10-01 |website=ec.europa.eu |language=en-GB}}</ref> [[OECD]],<ref>{{Cite web |last=OECD |title=Environmental indicators, modelling and outlooks |url=https://www.oecd.org/environment/indicators-modelling-outlooks/ |access-date=2023-10-01 |website=OECD}}</ref> and [[United Nations Environment Programme|UNEP]]<ref>{{Cite journal |date=2021-06-25 |title=A Global Manual on Economy Wide Material Flow Accounting |url=https://www.resourcepanel.org/reports/global-manual-economy-wide-material-flow-accounting |journal=[[UNEP]].
